title: Lⁿ = Hⁿ = Hⁿ_δ on ℝⁿ and the isodiametric inequality (Simon 2.9, 2.10)
statement: For every n ∈ ℕ, every real δ > 0 and every A ⊆ ℝⁿ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n): Lⁿ(A) = Hⁿ(A) and Hⁿ(A) = Hⁿ_δ(A), where Lⁿ is Lebesgue outer measure and Hⁿ, Hⁿ_δ are Simon's normalized Hausdorff measure and size-δ approximation (2.1), (2.2); and for every n ∈ ℕ and A ⊆ ℝⁿ: Lⁿ(A) ≤ ω_n (diam A / 2)ⁿ with ω_n = π^{n/2}/Γ(n/2 + 1).
